raw_segments.text: Distimona. Why then to-morrow night or Tuesday morn on Tuesday noon or night on Wednesday
morn? I prithee name the time but let it not exceed three days. In faith he's penitent,
and yet his trespass in our common reason save that they say the wars must make examples
out of their best is not almost a fault to incur a private check. When shall he come?
Tell me, Othello, I wonder in my soul what you would ask me that I should deny or stand
Michael Cassio, that came a-wooing with you, and so many a time when I have spoke of you
disbracingly, hath tan your part to have so much to do to bring him in. Trust me, I could do much.
